# Lean Startup

Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT), listed here with credit to its creator @wondelai. Discovered via skills.sh. A complete Build-Measure-Learn advisor for founders: it designs minimum viable products, sizes validated-learning experiments, ranks leap-of-faith assumptions by risk, scores plans against a 10-point diagnostic, and applies innovation accounting with actionable (not vanity) metrics to drive pivot-or-persevere decisions. Honest notes: guidance only — it structures thinking, it doesn't validate demand or talk to customers for you; its worked examples (Dropbox, Zappos, Groupon) are the methodology's classics, not guarantees; the scoring rubrics are the skill's own, use them as a discipline not a verdict. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
